item.title: Version 1.8.0-beta.2
item.description:
SupaSidebar 1.8.0-beta.2

What’s New

  • Prevent Overlap Says Why - When the sidebar can’t clear your browser, a card names the cause and offers Try again and How to fix.
  • Freeze Note - After SupaSidebar freezes for 10 seconds or more, a note says for how long, which browser held it up and whether a report was sent.
  • Permission Warnings in the Sidebar - The sidebar now warns when Accessibility or a browser’s Automation access is off for a feature you use, with Fix right there.
  • Update Can’t Install - When SupaSidebar runs from a folder that blocks updates, a card offers to move it to Applications.
  • Try Again When Tabs Can’t Be Read - When a browser’s tabs can’t be read, Live Tabs keeps the last ones dimmed and offers Try again.
  • Undo After Saving a Page - The Page Saved toast now has Undo, so a page saved by mistake comes right back out.
  • Route Notice - When an Air Traffic Control route opens a link in another browser, a toast names the route and offers Edit Route.
  • Numpad Keys Switch Spaces - ⌘⌃ with numpad 1-9 now jumps to Spaces 1-9, like the number row, with a Use Numpad Keys switch.
  • Opera Support - Opera, Opera GX and Opera Air now work with Live Tabs, Recents, linked Spaces and opening links.
  • Crest in Labs - Turn on Crest Browser in Labs to use Crest with Live Tabs and Spaces, free for everyone.
  • New Window Note - When a Space switch opens a new window of its linked profile, a note says why, and warns if no window appears.

Improvements

  • One Look for Every Notice - Sidebar notices now share one off-white card with dark text that stays readable on every Space color.
  • Notices Stack at the Bottom - Warnings, updates, What’s New and Space notes now stack in one deck at the bottom of the sidebar, with Clear all.
  • Countdown on Notices That Close Themselves - Notices that leave on their own now show a countdown ring around their x, and hovering holds them.
  • Switch Note Says Why - After an automatic Space switch, the note names the Space and the browser or profile it’s linked to, then closes after 6 seconds.
  • Turn Notices Off in Settings - General, Notifications now lists each sidebar notice with its own switch, and Spaces settings has one for each switching note.
  • Waiting Line for Slow Browsers - While a browser is slow to share its tabs, Live Tabs shows a waiting line first and Try again after 15 seconds.
  • Live Tabs Star Works Like a Bookmark Star - The star now shows Page Saved with Undo, and clicking a filled star removes the page, also with Undo.
  • Note When Every Tab Is Saved - With saved tabs hidden, Live Tabs now says when every open tab is already saved and offers Show.
  • Regex Length in the Route Editor - The route editor now counts a regex’s characters as it nears the 500 limit and says how far over it is.
  • One Picker in Edit Space - Edit Space now has a single picker for the linked browser or profile, the same as New Space.
  • Clearer Free Plan Screen - When a trial ends, the license screen now says you can keep using SupaSidebar without a license key.
  • Help With Blocked Imports on macOS 27 - When macOS 27 blocks a browser import during setup, onboarding now points to the Files & Folders switch.
  • Smoother Folder Drags - Dragging over a sidebar with about 100 folders now takes the Mac roughly 18 times less work.
  • Smoother Card Closing - Closing a sidebar card now fades it out before the tabs below slide up.

Bug Fixes

  • The sidebar now stays below the menu bar after a relaunch or a resize when Draggable Sidebar is on.
  • Prevent Overlap, Smart Attach and tiling no longer stop working while VLC or another app keeps a screen-sized window open.
  • Moving, dragging or tidying folders no longer freezes the sidebar on macOS 26 and later.
  • Edit Space now saves a changed linked profile, so links, Live Tabs and window switching follow it.
  • A Save Page that fails no longer gets saved anyway by your next change.
  • The main window now appears once, fully drawn, at launch instead of after a Loading window.
  • The license screen now fades in smoothly and stays centered after onboarding.
  • Choosing Keep when macOS asks about your default browser no longer shows an error.
  • The Review permissions button on the linked profile note is now visible on white and yellow Spaces.
  • The collapse arrow in Space and section headers now matches the Space’s color.
  • The Spaces icon in Settings now lines up with its title.

Notes

  • Send Crash Reports in Settings, About, Privacy now works, so crash and freeze reports reach SupaSidebar while it’s on.

item.title: Version 1.7.1
item.description:
SupaSidebar 1.7.1

SupaSidebar 1.7.1 brings linked profile windows to the front, keeps Live Tabs steady as you close tabs, lets Hover Delay reach 0s, and locks the MCP connection with an access key.

Improvements

  • Hover Delay Down to 0s - Set Hover Delay to 0s and the sidebar appears the moment your cursor reaches the screen edge.
  • Room Past the Last Live Tab - Live Tabs now scrolls a little past the last tab, so it no longer sits against the bottom bar.
  • Clearer Linked Profile Loading - Live Tabs now says when it’s opening a window or loading its tabs, and why a list is empty.
  • Onboarding Built Around Your Browser - New users get ⌃Tab on its own screen, and the Command Panel and browser keys screens show what each one replaces.

Bug Fixes

  • Grant Access now adds SupaSidebar to the Accessibility list, so you no longer have to add it with +.
  • Switching to a Space linked to a closed browser profile now brings its new window to the front and loads its tabs.
  • Clicking another browser after closing a linked profile’s window now switches to that browser’s Space.
  • Closing a linked profile’s window with ⌘W now brings the sidebar back and switches to the Space of the window behind it.
  • Closing Live Tabs at the end of a scrolled list now slides the next tab under your pointer instead of the one above it.
  • With Stage Manager on, clicking a Live Tab in a minimized window now brings that window to the front.
  • Websites can no longer send commands to SupaSidebar’s MCP connection, which now requires a private access key.

Notes

  • If an AI app reaches SupaSidebar through MCP, update supasidebar-mcp to 0.2.4 or later, since older versions can no longer connect.
